headline: Former Gulistan-i-Jauhar SHO Kamran Qureshi was dismissed from service on Saturday for misconduct in the Mir Raza Ali murder case, including failing to secure the crime scene, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Crime scene mehfooz na karne par naukri se nikala gaya

caption:
Mir Raza qatl case mein sabiq SHO naukri se bartaraf! 🚔
Dawn ke mutabiq Karachi ke Gulistan-i-Jauhar thane ke sabiq SHO Kamran Qureshi ko Saturday ko misconduct ki wajah se naukri se nikal diya gaya. Inquiry ke mutabiq unhon ne crime scene mehfooz nahi kiya aur Crime Scene Unit ko nahi bulaya, jis se forensic kaam mein der hui. Unhon ne show-cause notice ka jawab bhi nahi diya. 25 saal ke karobari Mir Raza Ali July mein laapata hue thay. Pehle police ne is maut ko khudkushi samjha, lekin baad mein judicial commission ne ise qatl qaraar diya.
Kya is faisle se police ka nizam behtar hoga? Comment mein batayein 👇
